papers.title: The Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Heterogeneous Structures TA15 Alloy Fabricated by Laser Powder Bed Fusion‐Vacuum Hot Pressing Composite Process
papers.abstract: In this work, heterogeneous structures inspired by natural architectures were introduced into TA15 alloy, endowing the alloy with excellent strength and toughness. The 3D porous TA15 skeleton was fabricated by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF). The skeleton was then filled with TA15 powders, followed by the vacuum hot pressing (VHP) treatment. The resulting heterogeneous structure reveals a distinct periodic distribution with coarse‐grained and fine‐grained. The heterogeneous structure exhibits a combination of high strength (1083.56 MPa) and high ductility (19.24%), which are superior to the fine grains obtained by direct LPBF process (1147.4 MPa and 8.11%). The lamellar structure and <0001> texture of the skeletal region suppresses the slip, resulting in uneven strain distribution and a higher density of geometrically necessary dislocations, which are the reasons for the enhanced strength and plasticity of the heterogeneous structure.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TA15合金的异质结构力学性能，但未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 受自然结构启发，在TA15合金中引入异质结构以提升强韧性。
summary_zh.method: LPBF制备多孔骨架，真空热压填充粉末形成粗晶-细晶周期性分布。
summary_zh.result: 异质结构强度1083.56 MPa，塑性19.24%，优于直接LPBF细晶。
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试（拉伸）和微观组织表征。

summary_en.motivation: Inspired by natural architectures, heterogeneous structures were introduced into TA15 alloy to achieve superior strength and toughness.
summary_en.method: A 3D porous TA15 skeleton was fabricated by LPBF and then filled with TA15 powders via vacuum hot pressing, forming a periodic coarse-grained and fine-grained structure.
summary_en.result: The heterogeneous structure exhibited a high strength of 1083.56 MPa and high ductility of 19.24%, outperforming the fine-grained counterpart from direct LPBF.
